name: Analytics with charts
summary: Range filter in the header and a responsive grid of chart cards built with ChartContainer (Recharts), token colors, tooltip, legend and a screen-reader summary.
description: Trend and breakdown charts for an analytics page or a dashboard section. ChartContainer maps each series in a ChartConfig to a --color-<key> CSS variable, so series colors come from Nucleux tokens and switch with the theme.
whenToUse: Showing change over time or comparisons across categories.
whenNotToUse: A few headline numbers: use MetricCard tiles from dashboard-overview.
Exact values users need to read or export: use a table (list-page).

children.role: Page header: <h1> title + muted description, flex-col sm:flex-row; actions slot holds the range NativeSelect
sr-only text summary of the chart
config + one Recharts chart (LineChart, BarChart…), aria-hidden

layout: One chart per card with a title that says what it measures.
Give ChartContainer an aspect ratio (aspect-[16/9] w-full) so it sizes responsively.
Series fill/stroke use var(--color-<key>) from the ChartConfig.
responsive: Cards stack below lg, two columns from lg.
Fewer x-axis ticks on narrow cards: keep labels short ("Oct 5").
tokens: Series colors: hsl(var(--nx-info)), hsl(var(--nx-success)), hsl(var(--nx-brand)), hsl(var(--nx-warning)), hsl(var(--nx-destructive))
accessibility: Charts are visual only: add an sr-only text summary and mark ChartContainer aria-hidden, or offer a table view.
Don't rely on color alone: use the legend and distinct chart types or dash patterns when series are many.
states: Loading: Skeleton at the chart's aspect ratio inside the card. No data: Empty inside the card.
antiPatterns: Hex or Tailwind palette colors for series.
Importing Recharts' Tooltip/Legend instead of ChartTooltip/ChartLegend with the Nucleux content components.

npm.name: recharts
npm.reason: Chart primitives (LineChart, BarChart, XAxis…) rendered inside ChartContainer. Install the version @nucleux/chart depends on (^2.15).
